newsitem.title: TURKEY: Fire at Turkish Hyundai plant injures 29.
newsitem.headline: Fire at Turkish Hyundai plant injures 29.

text.p: A fire broke out after an explosion at a Hyundai car factory in western Turkey on Tuesday injuring 29 workers, state-run Anatolian news agency said.
An official at the Hyundai automotive plant in Izmit confirmed to Reuters that the fire had broken out but declined to give any further details.
Anatolian said that 29 workers had been taken to hospital for checks after inhaling smoke from a blaze which broke out in the paint mixing department at around 3.00 p.m. (1200 GMT).
The fire had been extinguished, it said.
There were no details of any damage to the plant.
